InitPiranha.name: Init: Piranha Plant position
summary: Centers the plant horizontally between the two pipe tiles (X += 8) and moves it up one pixel (16-bit decrement of Y).

CallSpriteMain.name: Dispatch sprite main routine
summary: Runs the main routine for the current sprite (status 8) through the pointer table SpriteMainPtr that follows the JSL.
Parameters: X = sprite slot. Clears [$1491] first.

SpriteMainPtr.name: Pointer table: sprite main routines
summary: 2-byte pointers (bank $01), indexed by sprite number $00-$C8. Used by CallSpriteMain for sprites in normal status.
Sprites handled in other banks go through small wrapper routines below (Bank3SprHandler etc.).

InvisSolid+Dinos.name: Invisible solid block, Dino Rhino and Dino Torch
summary: Wrapper: calls the bank $03 routine for sprites 6D-6F.

GoalSphere.name: Goal Point Question Sphere
summary: Sprite 4A, the sphere that ends the level (secret exit goal). Draws itself, sparkles, and when Mario touches it erases itself,
starts the end-of-level timer and requests the course clear music.

InitReznor.name: Init: Reznor
summary: Wrapper: calls ReznorInit in bank $03.

Bank3SprHandler.name: Run Run bank $03 sprite main
summary: Wrapper for many sprites whose code lives in bank $03 (see table).

BanzaiBnCGrayPlat.name: Banzai Bill, ball and chain, grey platform
summary: Wrapper: calls Banzai+Rotating in bank $02.

BubbleWithSprite.name: Bubble with sprite
summary: Wrapper: calls BubbleSpriteMain in bank $02.

HammerBrother.name: Hammer Brother
summary: Wrapper: calls HammerBrotherMain in bank $02.

FlyingPlatform.name: Hammer Brother flying blocks
summary: Wrapper: calls FlyingPlatformMain in bank $02.

InitHammerBrother.name: Init: Hammer Brother (does nothing)
summary: Calls a bare RTL; no initialization is needed.

VolcanoLotus.name: Volcano Lotus

summary: Wrapper: calls SumoBrotherMain in bank $02.

Chucks.name: Chargin' Chuck and variants

MovingLedge.name: Moving ledge hole in ghost house

Unused0187C5.name: Unused. Sumo Brother wrapper

Layer3Smash.name: Layer 3 smash (Layer 3 Smasher)

summary: Wrapper: sets the data bank to $02 and calls PeaBouncerMain in bank $02.
Sprites 6B, 6C (spring boards on the wall).

RipVanFish.name: Rip Van Fish
summary: Wrapper: sets the data bank to $02 and calls RipVanFishMain in bank $02.

WallFollowers.name: Wall followers: Spike Top, Urchin, Fuzzy

InitWingedCage.name: Init: winged cage (unused)
summary: Wrapper: sets the data bank to $02 and calls Return02CBFD in bank $02.
Does nothing useful: calls a bare RTL (CBFD).

WingedCage.name: Unused. Winged cage
summary: Wrapper: sets the data bank to $02 and calls WingedCageMain in bank $02.

Dolphin.name: Dolphin
summary: Wrapper: sets the data bank to $02 and calls DolphinMain in bank $02.
Sprites 41-43 (horizontal and vertical dolphins) share it.

InitMovingLedge.name: Init: moving ledge hole
summary: Moves the sprite up one pixel (Y position low -= 1, no high-byte borrow).

JumpOverShells.name: Yellow Koopa: jump over incoming shells
summary: Every 4th frame (staggered by sprite slot) looks for a kicked shell (status $0A) in slots 9..0. If one is close enough to the
sprite and the sprite is on the ground and facing the other way, the sprite jumps (Y speed $C0).
Parameters: X = Koopa sprite slot.

HandleJumpOver.name: Check shell proximity and jump
summary: Builds a detection box around the shell in slot Y: X = shell X - $1A (16-bit), width $44, Y = shell Y, height $10,
tests it against this sprite's hitbox, then makes the sprite jump if it is on the ground and facing the opposite way to the shell.

Spr0to13SpeedX.name: Table: walking speed X
summary: Indexed by direction (0 right, 1 left), +2 for fast sprites: right $08, left $F8, fast right $0C, fast left $F4.

Spr0to13Prop.name: Table: Koopa/Goomba property flags
summary: Indexed by sprite number $00-$13. Bit 0 = fast walker, bit 1 = stays on ledges (turns at edges), bit 2 = turns to follow Mario,
bit 3 = jumps over shells, bit 7 = flutters wings in the air. Other bits are not used by this code.

ShellessKoopas.name: Shelless Koopa (sprites 00-03)
summary: Main routine for the naked Koopas. Not locked: runs the timer/kick logic below. Locked: animates and interacts only.
Uses timer [$163E,X] (wait/kick), [$160E,X] (slot of the sprite it kicks), [$1528,X], [$1534,X] (kick state flags), [$C2,X] (kick pose timer).
The blue Koopa (sprite 02) behaves slightly differently from the others.

NOTE.name: Shelless Koopa logic, part 2
summary: Continuation of ShellessKoopas (the 'NOTE' label comes from a stray comment in the source).
$0189FD: stopped sliding, set wait timer. $018A15: follow-through of a kick (slow the kicked sprite). $018A88: kick pose timer.
$018A9B: when [$1558,X] = 1, check the touched sprite and, on contact, erase the Koopa and mark that sprite (shell re-entry, probably).

ExplodeBomb.name: Bob-omb explodes
summary: Wrapper: sets the data bank to $02 and calls ExplodeBombRt (bank $02), which turns the Bob-omb into an explosion.

Bobomb.name: Bob-omb
summary: Bob-omb main routine. [$1534,X] set: exploding. Otherwise walks like a Koopa until its fuse timer [$1540,X] is zero,
then becomes a stunned sprite (status 9) with a $40 frame fuse and keeps drawing itself.

Spr0to13Start.name: Koopa/Goomba/etc: start
summary: Entry for sprites 04-07, 0C, 0F, 11, 13 and the walking Bob-omb. Locked: only interact with Mario and sprites, and draw.
Otherwise falls into Spr0to13Main.

Spr0to13Main.name: Walking sprite: speed, collisions, movement
summary: Per-frame logic for the generic walkers. On the ground: sets the walking speed from direction and the property table.
Stops at walls and ceilings, despawns offscreen, moves and animates, then continues in SpriteOnGround / SpriteInAir.

SpriteOnGround.name: Walking sprite on the ground
summary: Sets the resting Y speed, then handles the follow-Mario and jump-over-shell property flags.

DontFollowMario.name: Walking sprite: jump over shells
summary: Restores the property flags and, if bit 3 is set, runs JumpOverShells; then continues at $018BB0.
